shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>&1; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -iE 'vitest|tsc|vite'

grep -nE "theme|Theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/dom-helpers.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/constants.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useSystemTheme.js; echo ---; grep -oE "\.g-root[^{]*\{[^}]*\}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | grep -E "body|background|margin" | head; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -iE "segmented|radio|switch|select"; echo ---; ls node_modules | grep -iE "jsdom|happy-dom|testing-library"; ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null

grep -oE "\.g-root\{[^}]*\}|body\{[^}]*\}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -5; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---; grep -n "size\|variant\|color" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -20

grep -n "interface ControlGroupProps" -A 20 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo ---; grep -oE "\.g-root[^{,]*\{[^}]{0,200}\}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | grep -iE "background|color:" | head -5; grep -c "g-root" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css; grep -oE "body\s*\{[^}]*\}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | head
tr '}' '}\n' < node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | grep -E "^\.g-root[^_{]*\{|^\.g-root_theme_(light|dark)\{|^body" | head -20
tr '}' '}\n' < node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | grep -E "^\.g-root \{|^body\.g-root" | head -5 | cut -c1-600
grep -oE "\.g-root\s*\{[^}]*\}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -2; echo ---; grep -oE "body\.g-root\s*\{[^}]*\}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -2

grep -n "g-root" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20; echo ---; sed -n '1,5p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | cut -c1-300; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -c 400 && echo && grep -n "@import\|\.g-root" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.scss 2>/dev/null | head
sed -n '137,142p;1780,1790p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
npm test 2>&1 | tail -15

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome chrome headless_shell 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/lib/node_modules /usr/local/lib/node_modules 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer"; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer"; echo "exit: $?"
mkdir -p .ssr-check && sed "s#'/home/sandbox/workspace/src/App'#'../src/App'#" /tmp/ssr-check/check.tsx > .ssr-check/check.tsx && npx vite-node .ssr-check/check.tsx 2>&1 | tail -8; rm -rf .ssr-check

rm -rf dist && mkdir -p .ssr-check && sed "s#'/home/sandbox/workspace/src/App'#'../src/App'#" /tmp/ssr-check/check.tsx > .ssr-check/check.tsx && npx vite-node .ssr-check/check.tsx 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s+at " | head -12
npx vite-node --options.deps.inline="@gravity-ui/uikit" .ssr-check/check.tsx 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s+at " | head -12; rm -rf .ssr-check

mkdir -p .ssr-check && sed -e "s#'/home/sandbox/workspace/src/App'#'../src/App'#" -e 's#const checked = .*#const checked = [...html.matchAll(/<input[^>]*>/g)].map((m) => m[0]).filter((t) => t.includes("checked")).map((t) => t.match(/value="([^"]+)"/)?.[1]);#' /tmp/ssr-check/check.tsx > .ssr-check/check.tsx && npx vite-node --options.deps.inline="@gravity-ui/uikit" .ssr-check/check.tsx 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s+at " | head -6; rm -rf .ssr-check /tmp/ssr-check; echo --- && git status --short
